identity.model: Linear one-dimensional single-spatial-Fourier-mode electrons, fixed ions.
identity.geometry: One velocity coordinate and one spatial Fourier mode.
identity.boundary: Finite velocity window; endpoint-inclusive full-weight rectangle quadrature. Fn4 weak derivative deposits cutoff deltas; selected smooth variant omits them.
assumptions: Velocity-window truncation and recurrence are separate from temporal integration error.

inputs.name: tt
inputs.constraints: Finite strictly increasing, same shape as dEt.

inputs.name: wr
inputs.description: Optional theoretical real frequency; returned metadata only.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: Mapping ttmp[T], lndE[T], lndEe[T] or None, wr,wi. Exact zero amplitude yields -inf; all samples retained.
outputs.shape: As described in output mapping or tuple.
outputs.constraints: Finite result except documented log-zero -inf and absent theory/diagnostics.

preconditions: dEt and tt are finite one-dimensional vectors with identical shape and at least two entries; tt is real and strictly increasing.
supported: Log-magnitude history and optional theoretical exponential envelope.
excluded: Peak fitting, nonlinear fields and continuum accuracy claims.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError for misaligned/nonfinite vectors or non-real/non-increasing times.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: NumPy floating-point results, including -inf for exact zero amplitudes, are returned according to the declared operation.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable; no iteration is performed.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No envelope mapping is returned after input validation fails.

provenance.lineage_summary: SciRel implements the declared one-dimensional linear Vlasov-Poisson relation in Python; direct tests cover the discrete closure, finite-grid evolution and diagnostic boundary cases.

example.code:
from scirel.kinetic.vlasov_poisson import vp_envelope
r=vp_envelope([1j,2j],[0,1])
assert r["lndE"].shape == (2,)
example.description: Compute the log-magnitude envelope for two complex field samples.

scope: Discrete Poisson constraint and off-diagonal rank-one feedback.
Dense matrix-exponential RK4 order; analytic free-streaming and damped-cosine diagnostics.
Slowing-down weak derivative integration-by-parts and default 2049-node/2000-step execution.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Independent semidiscrete mathematical and selected scenario regressions; actual run/installed-wheel receipts are recorded separately, not inferred from test existence.
known_limitations: Finite-window rectangle rule and sampling recurrence TR=2pi/(k*dv).
Fn4 truncated density retains original coefficient and is not renormalized after cutoff.
Peak diagnostic assumes standing oscillation; rotating complex exponential has no amplitude peaks.
